title: Braces Reject Narrowing
prompt: Complete `Config` with `name` (std::string, default "unset"), `port` (int, default 0), and `tags` (vector<string>, default empty), then implement `int truncateToInt(double d)` that compiles **only** because it avoids brace narrowing.

tests.name: defaults apply
tests.hint: Default member initializers: std::string name{"unset"}; int port{0}; std::vector<std::string> tags{};

tests.name: list-init with values
tests.hint: Brace/aggregate initialization sets every member in declaration order.

tests.name: truncate avoids narrowing
tests.hint: static_cast<int>(d) — the explicit cast is the honest way to narrow without braces.
